items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

ctx.x: The music, a lot of it seems to lend itself to some visual images. Has anybody ever approached you about doing that?

The only thing, years and years and years and years ago there was piece done on The Today Show with a photographer. It was about a photographer. Boyd Matson, I was trying to think of his name, Boyd Matson was the moderator and Bob Flick had something to do with that before he joined as head writer for, he’s now retired, from Entertainment Tonight. So the segment was about a photographer and they used the Cello Quartet music and it worked beautifully. So my wife is in video and she’s thought about it for many…
Great. You’ve done some fairly well known films, and do you like writing for film?
